_note: Shown beside each voice in Settings and the right-click menu. Gemini: Google's published table for these voice names (Chirp 3 HD). GPT-Live-1: OpenAI publishes none; female = the five voices the app has always used as feminine, supported by measured pitch (175-204 Hz); male = voices measured unambiguously low and narrow (median 92-111 Hz, 90th percentile under 150 Hz) with qa/voice-pitch-app.cjs on 2026-09-19. beacon (130 Hz, wide) and delta (157 Hz) are left unlabelled: the pitch method agreed with Google on only 20 of 30 Gemini voices, so it is not used where it is ambiguous.
